verdict.rationale: Blink claims you can "manage and edit files from the command line" and run small Python or Lua scripts inside the app, which suggests some in-app editing. Its keyboard docs mention Vim and Emacs, but only as keyboard-remapping examples, not as bundled editors. No named terminal editor appears in the listed built-in commands, and nothing shows syntax or lint checkers running in the app. missing for 10: a documented bundled terminal editor (e.g. vim), any evidence of syntax/lint checking tools running inside the app, hands-on corroboration.
